prompts.description: Extend Meal type + Zustand store with status tracking, bump PROFILE_VERSION with migration
prompts.prompt: Edit lib/meal-store.ts to add per-meal status tracking. Step 1: add and export `type MealStatus = "planned" | "eaten" | "skipped"`. Step 2: extend the existing Meal interface with a required field `status: MealStatus`. Update any meal-normalization helper so meals without status default to "planned". Step 3: bump PROFILE_VERSION from 2 to 3 and add a new branch in the existing migrate() (or persist migrate callback) that — when migrating from version <=2 — walks persistedState.weekPlan (if present) and sets meal.status = "planned" on every meal lacking one. Do NOT discard the existing weekPlan. Step 4: add four new store actions on the existing store interface and implementation: setMealStatus(dayIndex: number, mealIndex: number, status: MealStatus); cycleMealStatus(dayIndex: number, mealIndex: number) cycling planned→eaten→skipped→planned; skipDay(dayIndex: number) setting every meal that day to "skipped"; resetDayStatuses(dayIndex: number) setting every meal that day to "planned". All four must update immutably via set. Do NOT touch grocery, nutrition, swap logic, or API routes. Verify: npm run build passes.

prompts.description: Reset meal status to 'planned' when a meal is swapped
prompts.prompt: Building on the previous step, edit only the swapMeal(dayIndex, mealIndex, newMeal) action in lib/meal-store.ts. When the new meal is inserted into weekPlan[dayIndex].meals[mealIndex], force status: "planned" on the inserted object regardless of what value (if any) newMeal.status carries. Keep the existing day-totals recomputation untouched. Do NOT modify any other action, the swap API route, or components/meal-swap-sheet.tsx. Verify: npm run build passes and swapping a meal previously marked Eaten resets it to Planned in the store.

prompts.description: Render cycling status pill on each meal card in Daily View
prompts.prompt: Edit components/daily-view.tsx only. For each meal card rendered in the active day, add a status pill button at the bottom-right of the card that calls cycleMealStatus(dayIndex, mealIndex) from the Zustand store on click. Pill styling: 24px height, fully rounded, text-xs font-medium, inline-flex with 4px gap for icon. Planned uses bg #F1F5F2 text #26603F label "Planned" (Korean: "예정") no icon. Eaten uses bg #26603F text #FFFFFF Lucide Check icon size 12 label "Eaten" (Korean: "먹었어요"). Skipped uses bg #FCEBEA text #B23A48 Lucide X icon size 12 label "Skipped" (Korean: "건너뜀"). When status === "skipped", apply line-through to the meal-name text only — not to macros, ingredients, or recipe. Read language from useMealStore() to switch Korean. Stop click propagation so tapping the pill does not open any existing meal-detail expansion. Do NOT change layout of macros, recipe, or swap button. Verify: npm run build passes and the pill cycles through three visual states on click.

prompts.description: Add 'I skipped today' button + AlertDialog in Daily View header
prompts.prompt: Continue editing components/daily-view.tsx. In the Daily View header row (where the day selector lives), add a Button variant="outline" size="sm" to the right side with Lucide CalendarX icon size 16 and 4px gap and label "I skipped today" (Korean: "오늘 다 건너뛰었어요"). Clicking it must open a shadcn AlertDialog imported from components/ui/alert-dialog. Dialog title: "Mark all of today's meals as skipped?" (Korean: "오늘 식사를 모두 건너뜀으로 표시할까요?"). Dialog body: "This sets every meal for the active day to Skipped. You can undo per meal afterwards." (Korean: "오늘의 모든 식사가 건너뜀으로 표시돼요. 식사별로 다시 변경할 수 있어요."). Actions: AlertDialogCancel "Cancel" / "취소"; AlertDialogAction "Confirm" / "확인" — on confirm call skipDay(selectedDay) from the store then close the dialog. Hide the button entirely when weekPlan.length === 0. Use local useState for dialog open/closed; do NOT add new global state. Verify: npm run build passes; tapping Confirm sets every meal card's status pill on the active day to Skipped.

prompts.description: Recompute Daily View consumed totals from 'eaten' meals only, show Eaten vs Target
prompts.prompt: Continue in components/daily-view.tsx. Replace the existing day totals row with a new layout that distinguishes consumed vs target. Compute eatenMeals = meals.filter(m => m.status === "eaten") and sum calories/protein/carbs/fat across eatenMeals. Keep the existing userProfile calorie/macro targets as the denominator. Render two rows: row 1 — "Eaten {x} kcal / Target {y} kcal" (Korean: "먹은 양 {x} kcal / 목표 {y} kcal") with a progress bar below: track bg #F1F5F2 height 6px rounded-full, fill bg #26603F width = Math.min(100, eatenKcal / targetKcal * 100)%. Row 2 — three macro chips inline: "P {x}/{y}g", "C {x}/{y}g", "F {x}/{y}g" (Korean labels 단백질/탄수/지방). Do NOT mutate any dayTotals field on DayPlan; compute these values inline at render. Remove the old totals row so they do not double up. Verify: npm run build passes; with every meal Planned, Eaten shows 0; marking one meal Eaten increases the values accordingly.

prompts.description: Create RecoveryNudge component and mount above meal list in Daily View
prompts.prompt: Create new file components/recovery-nudge.tsx as a "use client" component. Props: { dayIndex: number }. Inside, read weekPlan, userProfile, language from useMealStore. Compute day = weekPlan[dayIndex]; if missing return null. Compute skippedCount = day.meals.filter(m => m.status === "skipped").length; eatenKcal = sum of calories for status === "eaten"; targetKcal = userProfile.targetCalories; gap = targetKcal - eatenKcal. Render nothing if skippedCount === 0 OR gap <= 200. Otherwise render a card: bg #F1F5F2, left border 4px solid #26603F, rounded-md, padding 16px, with Lucide Sparkles icon size 18 color #26603F plus headline "You're {gap} kcal short today" (Korean: "오늘 {gap} kcal 부족해요"). Below, two Button variant="outline" size="sm": "Redistribute over remaining days" (Korean: "남은 요일로 나누기") and "Accept and move on" (Korean: "괜찮아요, 다음 식사부터"). Stacked on mobile, side-by-side at sm: breakpoint. Local useState<"idle" | "redistributed" | "dismissed">. Dismissed → return null. Redistributed → replace buttons with a tiny breakdown: remainingDays = 6 - dayIndex; if remainingDays <= 0 hide the Redistribute button entirely (only show Accept). Otherwise show "Add ~{Math.round(gap / remainingDays)} kcal per day to the next {remainingDays} days." plus a "Got it" (Korean: "알겠어요") button that dismisses. The underlying weekPlan must NOT be mutated. Then edit components/daily-view.tsx to import RecoveryNudge and mount <RecoveryNudge dayIndex={selectedDay} /> directly above the meal list (below the totals row, above the first meal card). Verify: npm run build passes; marking enough meals Skipped to exceed 200 kcal gap causes the nudge to appear; pressing Accept dismisses it for the session.
